lsof.why: Listening sockets and their owning processes come from lsof on macOS.

cloudflared.why: The expose action can create a temporary public tunnel.

ifconfig.why: Interface addresses label which listeners are reachable from the LAN.

ip.why: Interface addresses label which listeners are reachable from the LAN.

nettop.why: Per-connection counters add traffic rates on macOS.

ps.why: Process command lines and uptime come from ps on macOS.

ss.why: Per-socket counters add traffic rates on Linux.

tailscale.why: Serve and Funnel status label listeners already exposed through Tailscale.
